item.name: An unknown broker route is 404

item.name: The broker is registered in the Service Discovery
2. Logs: GET /logs on the gateway
Without the key: 401
An unknown level is 400
Make a request to follow: register a player

exec: pm.test('the gateway hands back a request id', () => pm.expect(id).to.match(/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/));

item.name: A request id chosen by the caller is kept
Download every service's logs

exec: // a traceback's own lines carry no time: they follow the line they belong to
pm.test('every line: instance | time LEVEL [service-component] message', () => {
pm.test('our five services are in it', () => ['gateway', 'discovery', 'broker', 'player', 'game'].forEach(s => pm.expect([...services]).to.include(s)));

item.name: Follow one request through every service

exec: pm.test('the gateway forwarded it', () => pm.expect(lines.some(l => l.includes('[gateway-proxy] POST /auth/register 201') && l.includes('req=' + id))).to.be.true);
pm.test('the broker took it off the player queue', () => pm.expect(lines.some(l => l.includes('[broker-http] POST /queues/player/auth/register 201') && l.includes('req=' + id))).to.be.true);
pm.test('the player service handled it, with the same id', () => pm.expect(lines.some(l => l.includes('[player-http] POST /auth/register 201') && l.includes('req=' + id))).to.be.true);

item.name: Only one service: ?service=game
Only problems: ?level=WARN
3. Queues and topics in the broker
Subscriber queue: gateway -> broker -> one player copy
The next message goes to the other copy (round robin in the broker)

exec: pm.test('a different copy than the first time', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Upstream-Instance')).to.not.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('firstCopy')));

item.name: A queue for an unknown service is 404
Topics each service subscribed to when it registered
Publishing needs the internal key
Publish to a topic nobody wants: accepted, no subscriber

exec: pm.test('the producer is not told who listens, only how many', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().subscribers).to.eql([]));

item.name: Event, end to end: register a player
Event, end to end: log in
Event, end to end: the player hosts a session
Event, end to end: 150 XP makes level 2 (a service call, through the broker)
Event, end to end: player -> broker topic -> game, in the logs

exec: pm.test('player published it to the broker', () => pm.expect(lines.some(l => l.includes('[player-events] published player.leveled_up'))).to.be.true);
pm.test('the broker delivered it to game', () => pm.expect(lines.some(l => l.includes('[broker-topic] player.leveled_up') && l.includes('delivered to game'))).to.be.true);

pm.test('game told the session, live', () => pm.expect(lines.some(l => l.includes('[game-events] received player.leveled_up') && l.includes('player ' + id + ' reached level 2, told 1 session(s)'))).to.be.true);

item.name: Event, end to end: delete the session
4. Topics list, gRPC between services, closed gateway
GET /topics: every topic, its subscribers and counts

exec: pm.test('the level-up of folder 3 was published and delivered', () => {
pm.test('every entry has its counts', () => topics.forEach(t => pm.expect(t).to.have.all.keys('topic', 'subscribers', 'published', 'delivered', 'waiting', 'dead')));

item.name: Thread per request: this request has a thread of its own

exec: pm.test('/health is answered off the count, the rest one thread each', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().request_threads).to.be.at.least(0));
pm.test('the gRPC pool and workers are threads too', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().threads).to.be.above(pm.response.json().request_threads));

item.name: Each instance registered its gRPC address

exec: pm.test('both player copies serve gRPC on 9081', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(grpc.player || {}).filter(a => a.endsWith(':9081')).length).to.be.at.least(2));
pm.test('both game copies serve gRPC on 9082', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(grpc.game || {}).filter(a => a.endsWith(':9082')).length).to.be.at.least(2));

item.name: Game -> broker -> Player over gRPC: the calls of folder 3, in the logs

exec: pm.test('the broker forwarded Get (the host check when the session was created)', () => pm.expect(lines.some(l => l.includes('[broker-grpc] /player.Player/Get OK') && l.includes('-> player at'))).to.be.true);
pm.test('a player copy answered it over gRPC', () => pm.expect(lines.some(l => l.includes('[player-grpc] /player.Player/Get OK'))).to.be.true);
pm.test('presence went the same way', () => pm.expect(lines.some(l => l.includes('/player.Player/SetPresence OK'))).to.be.true);

item.name: Events over gRPC: Publish to the broker, Deliver to the subscriber

exec: pm.test('player published with events.Broker/Publish', () => pm.expect(lines.some(l => l.includes('[broker-grpc] /events.Broker/Publish OK') && l.includes('topic=player.leveled_up'))).to.be.true);
pm.test('the broker delivered with events.Consumer/Deliver', () => pm.expect(lines.some(l => l.includes('[broker-topic] player.leveled_up') && l.includes('(gRPC)'))).to.be.true);

item.name: Closed on the gateway: POST /players/{id}/xp, even with a token

exec: pm.test('404: only services may grant XP, through the broker', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

item.name: Closed on the gateway: the internal key opens nothing there
Closed on the gateway: /<prefix>/internal/...
Closed on the gateway: a teammate's service-only route (GET /world/spawn-points)
Still open on the gateway: a player's own routes
The event streams are negotiated with the broker, not the gateway
The broker refuses a call between services without the key
The broker refuses its queues without the key (only the gateway has it)
5. Durable queues, dead letters, monitoring
Dead letters need the key
Publish an event game cannot read (player.leveled_up without a player)

exec: pm.test('202: the broker stored it for game', () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));

item.name: Game rejected it: it is in the dead letter channel

exec: pm.test('rejected at once, no retries wasted', () => { pm.expect(letter.reason).to.eql('rejected'); pm.expect(letter.attempts).to.eql(0); });

item.name: Put the dead letter back on its queue
Retried, rejected again: a new dead letter for the same event

exec: pm.test('one dead letter for it, a new one', () => { pm.expect(letters.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(letters[0].id).to.not.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('deadId')); });

item.name: GET /topics counts waiting and dead events

exec: pm.test('the dead one is counted', () => pm.expect(t.dead).to.be.at.least(1));

item.name: Unknown dead letter: 404
Load-based balancing: every player copy carries load

exec: pm.test('the broker has sent calls to both player copies', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.result.length).to.be.at.least(2));

item.name: Prometheus scrapes every instance, found through the Service Discovery

exec: pm.test('our five services are scraped', () => ['gateway', 'broker', 'player', 'game', 'discovery'].forEach(a => pm.expect(apps).to.include(a)));

pm.test('both player copies and both game copies', () => { pm.expect(apps.filter(a => a === 'player').length).to.be.at.least(2); pm.expect(apps.filter(a => a === 'game').length).to.be.at.least(2); });
pm.test('all of them up', () => targets.forEach(t => pm.expect(t.health, t.scrapeUrl).to.eql('up')));

item.name: The dead letters show in Prometheus

exec: pm.test('at least the one of this folder', () => pm.expect(Number(pm.response.json().data.result[0].value[1])).to.be.at.least(1));

item.name: Grafana is up, with the dashboard

exec: pm.test('the dashboard', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().dashboard.title).to.eql('In Kahoots with the Undead'));

item.name: Loki has the logs of every container, the teammates' too
Loki knows our levels: the WARN and ERROR lines

exec: pm.test('levels parsed from our log format', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.include.members(['INFO', 'WARN', 'ERROR']));
